blocks.tamil_translation: to pay Zakat, to perform Hajj of the Baitullah, and to fast in Ramadan; in that month there is a night better than a thousand months. Regard as haram the killing of a Muslim and of a Dhimmi (one with whom a covenant has been made), and the seizing of their property. But if they commit some crime, they will be punished according to the command of Allah. And what I advise you is this: “Hold firmly to Allah and to obedience to Him (without caring about the pleasure or displeasure of others, remain courageously engaged in the work of the Deen)” — this too I advise,” said Rasulullah ﷺ,” narrates Hazrat Qurrah ibn Da'mus (RA)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مِفْتَاحُ الْجَنَّةِ الصَّلَاةُ وَمِفْتَاحُ الصَّلَاةِ الطُّهُورُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The key to Jannah is Salah, and the key to Salah is Wudu.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: جُعِلَ قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه النسائي باب حب النساء رقم:٣٣٩١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “The coolness of my eyes has been placed in Salah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: الصَّلَاةُ عَمُودُ الدِّينِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو نعيم في الحلية وهو حديث حسن الجامع الصغير:٢ /١٢٠
